Hospitalsenheden Vest is an administrative hospital unit operating within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] in the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. It is one of the regional hospital entities evaluated in the Annual Report 2022–2023 from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP). 

A key area of assessment for the unit is [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]], which measures the treatment coverage for anticoagulation in patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation. The national standard for this indicator requires a treatment coverage of at least 90%. However, for the evaluation period spanning July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, Hospitalsenheden Vest did not meet this target. The unit achieved a treatment proportion of 86.6% (95% CI: 82.4–90.1) [^src1]. 

Beyond anticoagulation coverage, Hospitalsenheden Vest is also tracked across other clinical quality metrics in the AFDK report. Data from the same reporting period shows the unit's performance on additional indicators, including patient counts and outcome percentages related to atrial fibrillation management—such as echocardiography performance and subsequent heart failure incidence—where it recorded varying figures across different sections of the report [^src2] [^src3] [^src4].
